verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's open.gsa.gov pages document concrete endpoints for Entity, Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy, and Assistance Listings APIs, including the entity URL. They also describe a key-issuance path (a Public API Key from the SAM.gov account-details page, plus approved System Accounts) and include an 'API Key Rate Limits' section alongside an OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: the actual rate-limit figures are not quoted in evidence (only the section's existence), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that key issuance and the endpoints work as documented (probes only show the OpenAPI spec isn't at conventional well-known paths).
